findings.finding: Coexisting manuscripts disagree on 161 H+M, 605 assigned, and audited 400 HIGH/185 Holdat-attested states. Even current MD alternates 605 HIGH with 413 independently confirmed plus 192 inferred. Filename version labels do not establish a single chronological latest scientific result.

Claim that ICIT was blind and no readings derived from it conflicts with ICIT integration/promotions; claim Elamite cognates were unused conflicts with cognate injection. Anchored SA consistency is not phonetic accuracy. No frozen per-sign training/test partition establishing independence is provided in the reviewed artifacts.

Reads first case-preserved character, compares Dravidian bigram support membership with uppercase ASCII uniform support, ignoring weights. Thus this is not probabilistic LM discrimination; header says five-way but function computes only two comparisons. Both currently pinned reviewed anchor tables have zero uppercase ASCII HIGH-reading initials, making uniform support unreachable for those states. Historical 400-HIGH key is not recovered here; its exact score is not recomputed.

Test1 uses flat_tokens with no boundaries and scores adjacent assigned signs across artifact boundaries. M77 likewise scores one returned flat symbol stream; its boundary handling cannot be verified without the unreviewed helper.

Deletes unassigned signs, bridging gaps; subtracts entropy of all retained tokens rather than first-endpoint marginal of counted pairs. The resulting h2 is not H(Y|X) for those bigrams. Full slash-separated reading strings are treated as labels, not resolved phonological transcriptions.
Phonological coverage is fixed at (25-6)/25 by a hardcoded missing list, not computed from observed initials and a specified inventory. Saved report gives attested=25 but missing=6 and verdict19/25.

Parpola table is hardcoded with no per-entry primary page mapping; comparing slash alternatives after diacritic removal and permitting three-character partials measures prior agreement, not verified phonetic correctness. The function loads all anchors rather than enforcing its HIGH-only framing.

Archived 400-HIGH state does not match pinned backend166 HIGH-reading state. Saved anchor summary has fields absent from anchor_summary function (holdat_attested_high, yajnadevam_only_high, non_holdat_non_yaj_high, note). Audit corrections report208 Holdat validated and50% Parpola, release report185 and80%. These may represent revisions or postprocessing but cannot be pooled as one byte-reproducible state.

Disagreement with another proposed key does not falsify its language without an independently correct reference. Neither entropy range, assigned coverage, optimizer consistency nor label uniqueness establishes semantic correctness.

direct_phonetic_anchor_status: None independently verified in reviewed artifacts. Iconographic-rebus suggestions and shared conjectural readings are hypotheses, not independently supplied sound values.

externally_grounded_name_attempts.twenty_five_names: All apparent >=50% fuzzy matches judged nondiscriminative by source
externally_grounded_name_attempts.conclusion: Source reports negative evidence, not a successful held-out reading prediction; no fresh prospective test performed here.

identity_claims.M012: No textual mention found in the three reviewed manuscript texts; absence is not evidence of correction.
identity_claims.M047: v4/currentMD explicitly call actual fish and equate P47.
identity_claims.limit: Primary glyph comparison belongs to parent audit. Graphic contradictions undermine stated iconographic basis, not a mathematical disproof of an arbitrarily assigned conventional sound.

summary: The release proposes a candidate Dravidian key, but the bounded review finds no verified decipherment or independently demonstrated phonetic reading. Scope/version mismatches, invalid controls, entropy and phonology calculations, and reused priors prevent the cited metrics serving as proof.
limitations: Private Holdat corpus not available in the reviewed release, so no exact historical score replication.
No validation of every DEDR/Elamite/Tamil-Brahmi citation; no assumption that all cognates are false.
Two transcription corpora need artifact-overlap and fixed-key audits before being treated as independent validation.
Current manuscript source claims are not endorsed facts.
